subject: RE: FW: VIENNA AIRPORT - LOS / 46 PLT 2,526 KGS
body:
Hi,

Could you quote your fastest air freight option to MEX (Mexico City, MX), with an all-in price in EUR? Please arrange truck pickup from our site in 41668 Moenchengladbach, Germany, and transport to the airport. The shipment is ready for pickup on 2026-11-24.

It's 12 pieces of electronic control units, 1133 kg gross and 3.87 cbm.

Please attach the offer as a PDF to your reply so our purchasing department can file it.

Sara
Lindqvist Medtech

Sent: 2026-10-12
Subject: VIENNA AIRPORT - LOS / 46 PLT 2,526 KGS

pls quote air freight ex VIENNA AIRPORT to LOS:
